## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link the relevant issue if one exists.

## Validation

- [ ] Unit tests and syntax checks pass.
- [ ] Relevant browser flows pass; include desktop/mobile screenshots for UI changes.
- [ ] Installation, usage, and changelog documentation reflect the change.
- [ ] No user images, model weights, credentials, or generated environments are included.

## Compatibility and limitations

Mention any export differences, migration needs, or known limitations.
